name: Dalsin Industries, Inc.
old_description: This year marks a remarkable milestone for Dalsin Industries, 80 years in business. Since 1945, our story has been shaped by the hard work, ingenuity, and dedication of employees, customers, suppliers, and partners who have stood alongside us through decades of change.
about:
Founded in 1945 in Bloomington, Minnesota, Dalsin Industries began as a metal fabrication shop built on principles of respect, hard work, and family values. The company has operated continuously for 80 years, evolving through strategic investments in automation and technology.

Today Dalsin provides full-service contract metal manufacturing and assembly for OEMs worldwide. Its capabilities span fiber laser cutting, high-volume sheet punching, automated panel bending and forming, robotic and manual welding, electro-mechanical assembly, and expert finishing. The company combines these processes with collaborative design assistance, design-for-manufacture optimization, production planning, and global supply chain management to deliver precision weldments, progressive stamped parts, and fabricated assemblies.

Dalsin serves industries including solar energy mounting and racking systems, fuel cell assemblies and enclosures, renewable energy storage, appliance, bus and recreational vehicle, automotive equipment, and DC racking and storage. Its customer base also extends to energy, transportation, power management, materials handling, and construction sectors, with long-term relationships spanning decades.

The company differentiates itself through a 'Better by Design' philosophy that emphasizes early engineering collaboration to improve product performance and reduce costs. Sustainability initiatives include a rooftop solar array generating 46 percent of the facility's electricity and zero-waste programs. Dalsin holds ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certifications and pursues Green Waste certification.
